fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Turns on reference resolution and the outbox. Writes from FoaMES create time series records and events on the tenant; check the tenant's data and API quotas with Siemens.

fields.label: Gateway URL
fields.description: The region gateway of the tenant, for example https://gateway.eu1.mindsphere.io. Every API is reached as <gateway>/api/<service>/<version>/...

fields.label: CA Bundle Path
fields.description: Path on this server to a PEM file, when the gateway is reached through a proxy with a private CA.

fields.label: Method
fields.description: Technical Token Manager: the credentials of an application registered on the tenant (Developer Cockpit). Service Credentials: OAuth 2.0 client credentials issued by the tenant's Settings app.

fields.label: Application Name
fields.description: The application the credentials belong to, as registered.

fields.label: Host Tenant
fields.description: The tenant the application is registered on. Defaults to Tenant.

fields.label: User Tenant
fields.description: The tenant whose data is read and written. Defaults to Tenant.

fields.label: Token URL
fields.description: The tenant's token endpoint, for example https://<tenant>.piam.eu1.mindsphere.io/oauth/token.

fields.label: Entity Mappings
fields.description: Reference types resolve against these resources. Workstation and Location default to Asset Management assets. Map Item, Work Order, Operation, Batch and the rest to the Opcenter Intelligence resources that hold them, with the service path, resource, key field and label field taken from the Opcenter Intelligence API reference; a row also overrides a default.

fields.label: Pause Outbox
fields.description: Postings keep queuing but are not sent until this is cleared.

fields.label: Send Machine Production as Time Series
fields.description: Every few minutes, and whenever a machine's job changes, write one record on the machine's asset with the good and scrap counts, the running minutes and the job of the window since the last record. The machine's Workstation reference names the asset.

fields.label: Aspect
fields.description: The aspect (property set) on the asset type that holds the variables below. Create it once on the tenant.

fields.label: Send State Changes as Events
fields.description: Each state change of a machine that points at an asset becomes an event on that asset.

fields.label: Event Type ID
fields.description: Leave empty for the platform's standard event type (MindSphereStandardEvent). A custom type must carry the standard type's fields.

fields.label: Job Variable
fields.description: A string variable; the External ID of the machine's current job.

fields.label: State Variable
fields.description: A string variable; the machine's state at the window's end.
